steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the chicken completely dry with paper towels.
steps.tip: Dry skin is what makes it crisp.

steps.text: Mash the butter with 4 cloves of minced garlic, the zest of the lemon, the thyme, 1½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper.
Loosen the skin over the breast and rub half the butter underneath. Rub the rest all over the outside.
steps.tip: Slide your fingers in from the neck end and go slowly so the skin doesn't tear.

steps.text: Halve the zested lemon and put it in the cavity with the 2 remaining garlic cloves.
Toss the potatoes and onion with the olive oil and a pinch of salt. Spread them in a roasting pan and set the chicken on top.
Roast about 1 hour 10 minutes, until the thickest part of the thigh reads 165°F.
steps.tip: Check at 60 minutes. If the skin browns too fast, tent it loosely with foil.

steps.text: Rest the chicken 15 minutes, then carve. Spoon the pan juices over the chicken and vegetables.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and bell pepper until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, oregano and salt. Cook 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered, stirring now and then.
steps.tip: Add a splash more broth if it gets too thick.

steps.text: Taste and adjust the salt. Serve with cheese, sour cream and green onions.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
facts: Done when pink and curled into a C

steps.text: Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the linguine until al dente. Save 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season the shrimp and cook 1–2 minutes per side until pink. Move to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium. Melt the rest of the butter and cook the garlic and pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the pasta, ½ cup pasta water, lemon juice and parmesan. Toss until glossy, adding more water if needed.
Return the shrimp, scatter with parsley and serve right away.

recipes.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: Tortilla chips, avocado and cilantro to serve

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft.
Add the garlic, jalapeño, cumin and chili powder. Cook 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and whole chicken breasts. Bring to a boil, then simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Return the chicken with the beans and corn. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and season with salt. Serve topped with crushed chips, avocado and cilantro.
Heat the oven to 350°F and butter a 9×5 loaf pan.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl. Stir in the melted butter.
Mix in the sugar, egg and vanilla. Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over and stir.
Add the flour and stir just until no dry streaks remain.
steps.tip: Lumps are fine. Overmixing makes it tough.

steps.text: Pour into the pan and bake until a toothpick in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.
Pour the wet into the dry and stir just until combined.
steps.tip: A lumpy batter makes fluffier pancakes.

steps.text: Let the batter rest while the griddle heats.
Pour about ¼ cup per pancake. Flip when bubbles form on top and the edges look set.
Cook 1–2 minutes more until golden. Keep warm in a 200°F oven while you finish the batch.
